[[File:XanatosTelos.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] being held in energy cages on [[Telos IV]]]]
An '''energy cage''' was a type of metal cage used to imprison beings. If a prisoner touched the metal bars, the individual suffered a strong electrical burn. [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] were locked in energy cages by [[Xanatos]] during their [[Mission to Telos (44 BBY)|mission]] to [[Telos IV|Telos]].<ref name="DoR">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Day of Reckoning]]''</ref> The energy cage was based often on the same technology as an [[energy gate]].
